You can use this page
Route planning for animal travel
This note helps travelers prepare companion animals for trips between skyports. As the shift coordinator, I keep guidance practical so you can check requirements before you arrive and avoid delays at the desk.

Start by reviewing your pet's carrier, paperwork, and comfort needs. Clean bedding, secure closures, and familiar items can help an animal settle during the journey. If your route includes a transfer, plan for extra care during handoff and keep all documents close at hand.

At the desk, staff may direct you to screening, resting areas, or holding spaces based on the animal's needs and the day’s service conditions. <<FACT F028>> Follow staff directions on arrival, because calm handling and clear spacing help us move each traveler safely through the process. If your itinerary changes, tell the team as soon as possible so we can adjust the plan.

For ground movement at the skyport, use the pet relief area when it is available and keep your pet on lead or in the carrier as required. <<FACT F013>> Bring waste bags, cleaning supplies, and any comfort item your animal uses at unfamiliar places. If your pet shows stress, pause, speak softly, and wait for staff guidance before continuing.

Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk aim to keep instructions clear and humane for every traveler. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
